prompt:
You are an expert digital design engineer writing synthesizable Verilog.
Implement the module 'TopModule' according to the following specification.
Output ONLY complete, synthesizable Verilog code enclosed in a ```verilog ... ``` block.
Do not include testbenches or explanations.

SPECIFICATION:

I would like you to implement a module named TopModule with the following
interface. All input and output ports are one bit unless otherwise
specified.

 - input clk
 - input d
 - input q

The module should implement a single D flip-flop. Assume all sequential
logic is triggered on the positive edge of the clock.
raw_response:
```verilog
module TopModule (
    input clk,
    input d,
    output reg q
);

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        q <= d;
    end

endmodule
```
